plugins.name: WorkBuddy (CN + Intl)
plugins.description: WorkBuddy China and WorkBuddy AI (international) as CLIProxyAPI providers, with a WorkBuddy page in the management panel: sign-in for both builds, accounts, credits, models and settings, and a task center (check-in, streak rewards, cat travel, growth tasks, campaigns, mini program, night owl, international daily activity). Ported from magpie, workbuddy2api-hub and workbuddy2api-panel.
plugins.author: Sakuralaaa

zh-CN.name: WorkBuddy（国内版 + 国际版）
zh-CN.description: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版接入 CLIProxyAPI，并在管理面板里提供 WorkBuddy 专属页面：两个版本的登录、账号管理、积分、模型与设置，以及任务中心（签到、连登管家、猫猫旅行、成长任务、运营活动、小程序任务、夜猫子、国际版每日活跃）。
